column1: # Rotation corrections for JLCPCB pick-and-place files.
# JLCPCB's part library does not always use KiCad's zero-rotation orientation.
# Each row adds "rotation" degrees (and an offset in mm) to every placement
# whose footprint name matches the regular expression. First match wins.
# Rows below are copied from the Fabrication-Toolkit project (Apache-2.0)
# plugins/transformations.csv
# https://github.com/bennymeg/Fabrication-Toolkit
# They have NOT been checked against JLCPCB's placement preview for the parts
# in this repository. Check the preview when ordering and correct this file.
# Read again on 2026-11-10 for the revision A board
# families: the rows for TSSOP and convex resistor arrays are from the same
# file. The row for TI_SO-PowerPAD-8 is NOT in that file: it is an SOIC-8 body
# with an exposed pad and is given the SOIC rotation by analogy.
# Package families on the revision A board with no row
# own rotation: two-pin parts (chip resistors and capacitors
# SMC and SOD-123 diodes
# the module
# the cell holder. Whether JLCPCB's library agrees with KiCad for each of them
# is not known. hardware/zoneflow-a/output/zoneflow-a-pin1.csv says where pin 1
# of each polarised part is on the board
footprint_regex
^SOT-23
^SOIC-
^TI_SO-PowerPAD-8
^TSSOP-
^R_Array_Convex_
^QFN-
